offering_description.value: Manufactures and sells specialty construction products, HVAC and fluid-handling components, and engineered industrial products. Customers are contractors, building owners, industrial plants and equipment makers, sold largely through direct sales and distributors.

primary_products.value: roof coatings and sealants; HVAC components; industrial valves and hoses; specialty adhesives; plumbing and fluid products

customer_segment.value: B2B: roofing and building contractors, HVAC contractors, building owners, industrial manufacturers and plants

end_markets.value: construction; commercial buildings; HVAC; industrial manufacturing; plumbing

revenue_model.value: product sales: manufactured building products, industrial components and equipment sold to contractors, distributors and industrial customers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: makes products from raw materials and purchased components, sold to contractors, distributors and industrial customers; brand owner: markets its own branded construction, HVAC and industrial products through distributors and direct channels

geography_served.value: global: primarily US and Canada, with sales and some operations in Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: diversified: separate businesses: specialty construction products, HVAC and building components, and engineered industrial products

distribution_channels.value: distributors / dealers: building supply and industrial distributors, HVAC wholesalers; direct sales: direct sales to large contractors, OEMs and industrial accounts

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: environmental and safety rules on coatings and chemical products, such as EPA and VOC limits, plus building and product safety standards

notes: Segment structure and product mix may have changed; product and geography details are approximate.
divestiture_lines: P2.14: through a spin-off from CSWC, with operating companies that are long established names in their respective end markets.
